description: NaCBiSO₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁ space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.76 Å. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.23 Å) and two longer (1.35 Å) C-O bond lengths. Bi is bonded to six O atoms to form BiO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Bi-O bond distances ranging from 2.22-2.63 Å. S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent BiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 44-58°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.48-1.50 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one C, and one Bi atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one C, and one Bi atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Bi and one S atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, one Bi, and one S atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, one Bi, and one S atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Bi, and one S atom.
